chunks.rationale: The T3 flat-sidebar rewrite folded Delegating into the working tone, so it painted blue like Working. Restore a distinct 'delegating' tone on StatusLabelInfo and return it from the isDelegating branch. statusDotFor's tone is untouched: it is no longer used for colour, only for label/flags.
risks: data-dim previously keyed off tone === 'working'; delegating rows would have stopped dimming when unselected, so the check now covers both tones.

chunks.rationale: Adds --violet (#a78bfa, the pre-rewrite .badgeDelegating hue) and a .statusLabel[data-tone="delegating"] rule. Waiting/Stalled/Quota/Woke stay amber because they shared amber before the rewrite too.
risks: Violet on --card is ~5.4:1, in line with the other tones; no other consumer of --violet yet.

chunks.rationale: The whole #559 fix is this default becoming a stored number. Missing/junk → 10; explicit 0 must survive or the default would wipe the keep-everything hatch. setProjects maps migrateProject, so load and save both apply it.
risks: updateProject used to delete the key on 0; if that path still deleted, migrate would immediately rewrite 0 back to 10 and the hatch would be unreachable.

chunks.rationale: addProject returns the pre-setProjects object, so it must stamp worktreeRetention: 10 itself or callers see undefined. updateProject now stores 0 instead of deleting.
risks: EditProjectModal used to send 0 on an empty field. After prefill 10, a name-only save keeps 10; clearing the field still sends 0 (keep everything).

chunks.rationale: retentionFor treats stored 0 as keep-everything (does not fall back to 10). enforceRetention still uses explicitRetention > 0 so a 0 project is skipped even when a sibling is at 10. scheduleRetention swallows errors so archive/merge cannot fail on GC.
risks: After migrate, every existing project is 'configured' at 10, so the boot sweep and archive path will git-inspect every worktree dir. skipSizes avoids the #563 du storm; the git inspect cost remains.
Unmerged candidates are still skipped by enforceRetention; dirty/working/pinned still never drop. Branches are never deleted.

chunks.rationale: Reclaim on the transition, not only the 15s boot sweep. threads:setArchived, git:mergeWorktree, git:prMerge, thread_archive, thread_merge all call scheduleRetention. orch handlers must read userDataPath from createToolHandlers deps (tests call createToolHandlers, not createOrchServer).
risks: Awaiting the scan on archive makes a 166-dir machine wait on git inspect. Chosen over fire-and-forget so the archive test can assert the oldest dir is gone.

chunks.rationale: Count from threads that still hold worktreePath (no du). Click opens Settings (existing WorktreeGcSection). Hidden at 0. Scoped filter applies.
risks: Orphan directories (no thread pointer) are invisible here; Settings gcScan still lists them.
Bytes are omitted on purpose so the header never walks disk.
No test asserts data-tone anywhere, so the colour split is only covered by the existing 'Delegating' text assertions.

#601 taught that enforceRetention must stay opt-in so one project's setting cannot license reclaiming another's. That split remains (configured Set + explicit 0), but the default is now persisted so boot GC actually runs. Do not collapse retentionFor and explicitRetention.
A user who opens Edit project and clears Keep worktrees to empty/0 opts out of GC for that project.
